about: Provenance of every image and video file in this repository as it stood on 21 November 2026, taken from the repository's own records. The files themselves are not re-tagged; new generated or altered files are tagged in-file (IPTC Digital Source Type in XMP) when they are added.
ruling: Dermot, 21 November 2026: "If metadata allows then all altered or generated images may be tagged as such, from now on." Likewise for videos; for existing files, this list.

sources.photograph: the author's own frame as taken, or with darkroom work only (digitalCapture)
sources.edited-ai: one of his photographs altered by an image model
sources.composite-ai: a composite in which an image model made or placed part of the picture (compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia)
sources.generated: made by an image or video model from a prompt (trainedAlgorithmicMedia)
sources.composite: a composite made without an image model (compositeSynthetic)
sources.card: a designed graphic, diagram, sheet or screenshot (digitalCreation)
sources.third-party: other people's media under their own terms, never claimed by this repository
sources.unrecorded: the record does not settle how the file was made; no code is given rather than a guess
